declared_purpose: Explicitly: wrap capability-evolver, manage its loop lifecycle, send rich Feishu reports, visualize evolution metrics/history, and export raw history to Feishu Docs (SKILL.md:2-9,24-31; README.md:1-9; package.json:2-8). Automatic Git backup, persistent issue tracking, skill auto-healing, and model-routing directives are implementation choices. All packaged source was assessed; external execution, authentication, and helper behavior remain unresolved.

data_operations.operation: Read local integration health data and return issues
data_operations.source: Standalone check_health.js, or an external caller
data_operations.data_scope: FEISHU_APP_ID presence; memory/feishu_token.json contents to inspect expiry; temporary-directory existence and writability. Creates the temporary directory if absent. Outputs issue descriptions and caught error messages, without explicitly printing the access token.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local process and stdout to its caller
data_operations.condition: When check_health.js executes; its comment describes core integration, but the supplied wrapper does not configure that invocation.

data_operations.operation: Delegate evolution with inherited configuration
data_operations.data_scope: Filtered CLI arguments and the complete process environment, including any available credentials, reporting directives, hints, and model-routing instructions. Captures core stdout and stderr; buffers complete stdout for bridge extraction.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Resolved external evolver Node process; output returns to the wrapper and its stdout/stderr
data_operations.condition: Each core attempt after evolver resolution. Routing instructions name model preferences but do not themselves implement model API calls.

data_operations.operation: Extract, persist, and delegate an execution task
data_operations.data_scope: Core-produced task text, up to five recent failure lessons, status-writing instructions, and retry context. Writes the task to logs/task_<cycle>.txt, then passes task text as an OpenClaw CLI argument with the inherited environment and cycle/status-file variables.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local task file and external OpenClaw main-agent process; its output returns to wrapper buffers/stdout/stderr
data_operations.condition: Core exits successfully, stdout contains a bridge request, and task extraction succeeds. The supplied code does not establish OpenClaw's subsequent network recipients or session retention.

data_operations.operation: Persist and reuse failure diagnostics
data_operations.data_scope: Timestamp, cycle, reason, and up to 1,200 characters of failure details per entry. Reads the entire lesson file to select recent entries; bridge tasks receive the latest five.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: memory/evolution/failure_lessons.jsonl; later OpenClaw task input
data_operations.condition: Hand failures, exhausted or failed wrapper attempts, or circuit-breaker events. No lesson-file pruning is implemented.

data_operations.operation: Consume a one-time local hint
data_operations.data_scope: Nonempty memory/evolver_hint.txt contents; prints the hint, removes its source file, and sets EVOLVE_HINT for downstream execution.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Wrapper stdout and inherited child environment; source file is deleted
data_operations.condition: A readable, nonempty hint exists at the start of a cycle. Empty hints are not deleted by this function.

data_operations.operation: Read evolution state and infer operational status
data_operations.source: index.js cycle control and fallback reporting
data_operations.data_scope: Evolution events, intent, signals, gene identifiers, expected effects, blast-radius counts, and solidify state. Infers consecutive repair loops, successful recovery, and saturation to control signals, reports, and sleep intervals.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local wrapper state, child environment, generated status files, and subsequent report inputs
data_operations.condition: Applicable files exist; recovery reads occur after hand failures and saturation checks occur in loop mode. These are system-state inferences, not demonstrated human profiling.

data_operations.operation: Inspect processes and maintain lifecycle/watchdog state
data_operations.source: lifecycle.js, index.js singleton guard, and standalone daemon.sh
data_operations.data_scope: PID files, process command lines and working directories, log modification times, cycle/activity data, and health-check results. Persists PID, heartbeat, ensure-lock, and cron-check state. OpenClaw cron commands list jobs and create, enable, or change a watchdog.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local process/filesystem and OpenClaw CLI; status output normally stays with its caller
data_operations.condition: Relevant lifecycle command or daemon executes. Linux discovery scans /proc. Scheduling implementation is a 30-minute cron plus an internal five-minute check, differing from the entry document's ten-minute description.

data_operations.operation: Persist execution logs and temporary cycle status
data_operations.data_scope: Lifecycle timestamps, PID, cycle, duration, errors, and background stdout/stderr, including core/hand output and printed hints. Status JSON contains result and bilingual work descriptions; wrapper can generate fallback status.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: logs/wrapper_lifecycle.log; wrapper_out.log/wrapper_err.log or daemon.sh's evolver_loop.log; logs/status_<cycle>.json
data_operations.condition: Lifecycle logs append during attempts. Background output persistence depends on launcher. Existing status is removed before hand retries and after post-cycle reporting; no general log rotation is supplied.

data_operations.operation: Commit and remotely synchronize workspace data
data_operations.data_scope: Stages workspace skills, memory, assets, docs, and specified Markdown files. Commits the entire staged index, potentially including previously staged files. Writes a temporary commit-message file, pulls/rebases, and pushes origin main.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local Git index/history; repository configured as origin, whose URL and audience are absent; temporary /tmp commit-message file
data_operations.condition: Wrapper takes its successful path, synchronization is not throttled, and staged changes exist. The temporary message is deleted after a successful commit. Actual included files depend on repository state and ignore rules.

data_operations.operation: Inspect and repair local Git state; fetch remote history
data_operations.source: Standalone self-repair.js or an applicable external invocation
data_operations.data_scope: Git status filenames printed to stdout; aborts pending rebase/merge, deletes an index lock older than ten minutes, and fetches origin main.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local Git state and stdout; configured origin receives the fetch request
data_operations.condition: Module run() executes. The wrapper first prefers an external repair module; its supplied relative fallback does not resolve to this packaged file.

data_operations.operation: Discover a Feishu report recipient
data_operations.data_scope: Paginated accessible chat metadata, including names and chat IDs; selects the first name containing the evolution emoji. Uses options.target first and OPENCLAW_MASTER_ID only if discovery fails.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: GET requests to open.feishu.cn/open-apis/im/v1/chats; returned metadata remains in the reporting process
data_operations.condition: Report is not suppressed as stale and options.target is absent. Chinese wrapper reports pass FEISHU_CN_REPORT_GROUP when set; English post-cycle reports do not explicitly pass EVOLVE_TARGET.

data_operations.operation: Send evolution and user-supplied report cards
data_operations.data_scope: Target identifier, title, and supplied status/content or entire requested file. Plain cards send that content; summary cards send parsed goal/gene/signals or fallback status, duration/change metrics, and the first error only when summary.success is false. Ordinary reports add uptime/load. Target format determines chat_id, open_id, or email addressing.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Feishu message API at open.feishu.cn/open-apis/im/v1/messages and the selected chat/user
data_operations.condition: Valid content or dashboard requested, target resolved, and stale/dedup checks pass. Wrapper dispatch language is configurable, including both. API response data normally returns to its caller.

data_operations.operation: Forward diagnostics and lifecycle alerts
data_operations.source: index.js notification paths, lifecycle.js reports, and send-card-cli.js
data_operations.data_scope: Verbose-mode errors/warnings/lifecycle text; critical kill-switch path; retry-exhaustion reason; optional status PID/cycle/activity/action; watchdog/health failure descriptions. Errors also accumulate as 300-character session snippets.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Index diagnostics use LOG_TARGET then OPENCLAW_MASTER_ID through the Feishu message API; send-card-cli uses FEISHU_LOG_TARGET or LOG_TARGET; lifecycle reports use report.js target discovery
data_operations.condition: Index defaults to normal summaries; individual forwarded diagnostics require verbose mode, while critical/failure alerts have separate gates. Lifecycle status cards require --report; recovery alerts are automatic. CLI sends only when given a message and target.

data_operations.operation: Filter selected outgoing text for credential patterns
data_operations.data_scope: Legacy processed text and structured status are checked for four credential/private-key pattern families. Matches abort sending. Titles, notes, replacement cardData, structured error fields, and direct postCard payloads are not covered by these checks.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local validation before applicable Feishu sends
data_operations.condition: The corresponding helper is used; this is not a universal payload or history-export scanner.

data_operations.operation: Persist report identity, counters, and deduplication metadata
data_operations.data_scope: Report cache keys contain cycle, raw target, title, and a status hash; success logs contain timestamp, cycle, target, and duration. Cycle generation reads/writes evolution_state.json and may read all MEMORY.md to extract cycle IDs. Log dedup stores normalized-message hashes, timestamps, types, and hit counts.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: memory/report_dedup.json; logs/evolution_reports.log; memory/evolution_state.json; memory/evolution/log_dedup.json
data_operations.condition: Report dedup defaults on with a 30-minute window; log dedup is used for verbose forwarding, defaults to ten minutes and 800 keys. Pruning occurs on later calls, not by scheduled deletion. Successful report logs have no supplied rotation.

data_operations.operation: Compute and remotely report dashboard analytics
data_operations.data_scope: Reads all EvolutionEvent records; computes success rate, intent totals, recent outcomes, blast-radius averages, and averages of recorded personality-state values. Dashboard renders success totals, intent distribution, recent win/loss trend, inferred health, uptime/load, and cycle. Process count, RSS, disk usage, and computed averages are collected but not rendered.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local analytics process; rendered dashboard card goes to the report's selected Feishu target
data_operations.condition: Dashboard option is used without a summary, which takes branch precedence. External system-monitor may replace the supplied local fallback.

data_operations.operation: Prepare persistent issue tracking through external document helpers
data_operations.data_scope: Signals excluding three cosmetic/missing-context signals; cycle and timestamp; optional context capped at 500 characters, empty in the wrapper call. Creates/reuses a document token, optionally requests a master permission grant, and persists token, URL, creation time, and returned grant metadata.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: memory/evolver_issue_doc.json; /tmp/evolver_issue_<timestamp>.md; external feishu-doc/create.js and append_simple.js, intended to create/append a Feishu document
data_operations.condition: Actionable signals exist, a document is available, and helpers exist. Temporary Markdown is deleted after successful helper execution, but can remain on failure. CLI without --test prints saved state; --test supplies synthetic issues.

data_operations.operation: Export raw evolution history to a Feishu document
data_operations.data_scope: Loads workspace .env, reads the Feishu access-token file and complete evolution log. Extracts cycle details, removes bracketed substrings, truncates each to 500 characters, or falls back to the last 50 untruncated log lines. Sends every resulting chunk with bearer authorization.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: POST to open.feishu.cn/open-apis/docx/v1/documents/<FEISHU_EVOLVER_DOC_TOKEN>/blocks/<same identifier>/children; document content persistence. Progress and API errors go to local stdout/stderr.
data_operations.condition: Exporter is invoked, document identifier/access token exist, and the log is readable. Each invocation appends; no remote replacement or deletion is implemented.

data_operations.operation: Generate a local Markdown dashboard; conditionally read credentials and save it
data_operations.data_scope: Loads workspace .env; streams evolution events; computes aggregate metrics and recent activity with up to two signals per event; includes installed-skill health findings. Prints the Markdown. With FEISHU_EVOLVER_DASHBOARD_DOC_TOKEN set, reads the access-token file, then writes dashboard.md.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local process, stdout, and workspace/dashboard.md; no upload request exists in the supplied uploadToFeishu implementation
data_operations.condition: Events exist and are nonempty. dashboard.md is written only on the configured branch after token-file parsing succeeds; the parsed access token is unused.

data_operations.operation: Produce local weekly system-performance inferences
data_operations.data_scope: Reads all events, selects the last seven days using event IDs, aggregates intent/success and gene usage/failures, and infers low innovation, recurring failures, low activity, and gene warning statuses.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Overwrites logs/weekly_insight_report.md and prints its contents locally
data_operations.condition: Script executes and recent events exist; no scheduler or remote send is supplied.

data_operations.operation: Inspect installed skills and optionally modify them
data_operations.data_scope: Installed skill directory names, optional ignore-file entries, package metadata, entrypoints, and SKILL.md existence. For declared dependencies without local node_modules, executes the skill entrypoint through require(); separately performs syntax checks. Healing can install dependencies and create SKILL.md stubs.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local monitor and child processes; npm subprocess and configured package services if installation occurs; health findings return to the caller
data_operations.condition: Standalone run defaults to healing. visualize_dashboard.js calls with autoHeal:false, but entrypoint execution can still occur. report.js loads a monitor function but does not call it in supplied code.

data_operations.operation: Delete selected stale local artifacts
data_operations.data_scope: GEP prompt JSON/text files older than 24 hours outside the ten newest; external evolver error log older than 24 hours; main-agent session lock older than five minutes.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Deletion from local filesystem only
data_operations.condition: Each applicable function executes and age/existence checks pass. Packaged cleanup.js is standalone-callable; wrapper prefers an external cleanup module and its relative fallback does not resolve to the packaged cleanup.js.

data_operations.operation: Persist and consume local control signals
data_operations.data_scope: Wake marker, numeric cycle counter, and wrapper PID/lock files. Wake file is deleted when observed during sleep; own PID lock is removed on handled exit; stop removes wrapper/legacy PID files.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local memory/log directories; no remote disclosure from these control-file operations
data_operations.condition: Relevant trigger, sleep, cycle, exit, or stop path executes.

data_operations.operation: Expose conditional diagnostic caching and logging utilities
data_operations.data_scope: cachedExec stores command strings plus error/stdout/stderr in a process Map; results are reusable for one minute, but expired entries are not automatically deleted. Logger appends timestamp, level, message, and arbitrary supplied data, also printing them.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Process memory; logs/evolver.log and local console; command results return to the callback
data_operations.condition: Only when exported functions are invoked. Supplied index.js/lifecycle.js import these utilities but contain no calls to them.

potential_excess.data_scope: Broad workspace memory/assets/docs and any unrelated files already staged
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Local Git history and configured origin main
potential_excess.condition: Automatic gitSync reaches commit/push with staged changes.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Git backup is an implementation safety feature; the declared lifecycle/report/dashboard/history-export purpose does not require backing up all workspace memory.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: If backup is retained, synchronize the intended evolution changes.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Stage and commit an explicit cycle-owned allowlist; exclude credentials, session data, unrelated memory, and pre-existing staged changes. This narrows data in the backup action.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve selected code/history backup and commit metadata. Actual sensitive inclusion remains dependent on repository contents and ignore rules.

potential_excess.data_scope: Complete bridge task, appended failure lessons, and execution/report instructions
potential_excess.condition: A bridge task is extracted; no supplied cleanup removes these task files.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Execution passes attemptTask directly to OpenClaw. The later issue-tracker read only extracts signals.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Deliver the task and retain the signal subset needed for issue tracking.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Keep task text in memory and pass parsed signals directly, or delete the task file after signal extraction. Make longer diagnostic retention optional.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep task delivery, retries, and issue-signal reporting functional; this removes redundant full-text persistence rather than narrowing the agent's required task.

potential_excess.data_scope: Accumulating failure reasons and diagnostic excerpts
potential_excess.condition: Repeated failures append entries indefinitely, while the bridge uses five recent lessons.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Recent-failure learning supports retry recovery; retaining every older excerpt is not required by that demonstrated use.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Retain enough recent actionable lessons to guide retries.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Bound storage by count/age, deduplicate recurring failures, and retain concise sanitized causes instead of arbitrary output tails.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Retain at least the configured recent lesson window, including the five entries currently requested.

potential_excess.data_scope: Complete core/hand stdout and stderr, printed hints, and operational diagnostics
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Background wrapper output/error logs or daemon.sh's evolver_loop.log
potential_excess.condition: Wrapper is started through the supplied background launchers; files append without supplied rotation.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Lifecycle supervision needs activity and actionable failure information, not indefinite full execution transcripts.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Preserve heartbeat/activity detection and useful debugging information.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Use bounded rotation/retention and redact sensitive fields before logging; make full task/output diagnostics opt-in while retaining minimal heartbeat and error summaries.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Continue updating the files or replacement activity signals used by watchdog freshness checks.

potential_excess.data_scope: Accessible chat names/IDs and report delivery to the first emoji-matching chat
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Chat directory results in report.js; selected Feishu chat
potential_excess.condition: options.target is absent, including ordinary English wrapper reports.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: A report needs an intended recipient. Repeated broad discovery and a name-only audience heuristic are implementation choices.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Resolve the intended evolution-report destination and deliver its card.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Prefer an explicitly configured or previously verified report target; cache a verified discovery result. Require a verified selection for ambiguous matches.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve configured group reporting and master fallback. The source cannot establish whether the current first match is an authorized audience.

potential_excess.data_scope: Raw diagnostic text in verbose cards and failure reason/error excerpts
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Configured diagnostic Feishu target or report.js-selected chat/user
potential_excess.condition: Verbose forwarding or failure reporting is active. Structured error fields do not pass through the status-only secret scan.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Operational reporting requires the failure outcome and actionable cause; arbitrary stderr excerpts can contain additional context.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Deliver meaningful failure alerts and cycle results.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Send a sanitized error category and concise cause by default; redact every final card field and make detailed excerpts explicit. This narrows data in necessary alerts, independently of their frequency.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep enough detail to diagnose the failure. No actual leaked credential or private excerpt is established by the supplied source.

potential_excess.condition: FEISHU_EVOLVER_DASHBOARD_DOC_TOKEN is set and dashboard generation reaches uploadToFeishu.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: The implemented branch only saves local dashboard.md and never authenticates a remote upload.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Remove the token-file read and unused token variable from this local-save path.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep the same Markdown output. Add credential access only if an actual authenticated upload is implemented later; this removes a redundant read.

potential_excess.data_scope: Process count, RSS, disk usage, personality-state averages, and unused blast-radius averages
potential_excess.condition: Rich dashboard generation runs; these values are not consumed by the supplied renderer.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: The required dashboard renders aggregate outcomes, intents, trend, uptime/load, and cycle information.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Remove unused system probes and unused average calculations. This removes redundant local collection/computation, not fields presently sent to Feishu.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve rendered dashboard metrics and uptime/load. External system-monitor internals remain unknown.

potential_excess.data_scope: Issue signals and optional context in temporary Markdown
potential_excess.condition: The temporary file is written but execSync throws before successful-path deletion.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Temporary persistence supports helper input; retaining failed-upload input has no implemented recovery consumer.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Provide the issue Markdown to the append helper.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Delete the temporary file in a finally block; retain a sanitized failure summary separately if needed.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep the file available until helper completion and preserve intended document append behavior.

potential_excess.data_scope: Installed skill entrypoint execution and its inherited environment
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Child Node process; any further boundaries depend on the inspected skill
potential_excess.condition: skills_monitor.js checks a JavaScript skill with declared dependencies and no local node_modules, including visualization's non-healing check.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Dependency-health reporting is implemented by executing arbitrary entrypoint initialization, which may perform unrelated data operations.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Identify missing required dependencies and syntax problems.
